tool.name: HyphAeon bundle
tool.description: bundle per-orthogroup HyphAeon results into UCSC track BEDs and the TACC comparative bundle
tool.command: ## Stage every list collection keyed by element_identifier. In v0 every ## collection -- the five HyphAeon outputs and the raw codon alignments -- ## is keyed by the bare orthogroup id (one element per OG, unpartitioned). mkdir -p staged/meme staged/epistasis staged/dms staged/splits_nwk staged/splits_csv staged/aln autosql bundled && #for $j in $meme_jsons ln -s '$j' 'staged/meme/${j.element_identifier}.json' && #end for #for $j in $epistasis_jsons ln -s '$j' 'staged/epistasis/${j.element_identifier}.json' && #end for #for $j in $dms_jsons ln -s '$j' 'staged/dms/${j.element_identifier}.json' && #end for #for $n in $splits_newicks ln -s '$n' 'staged/splits_nwk/${n.element_identifier}.nwk' && #end for #for $c in $splits_csvs ln -s '$c' 'staged/splits_csv/${c.element_identifier}.csv' && #end for #for $a in $codon_alignments ln -s '$a' 'staged/aln/${a.element_identifier}.fasta' && #end for python '$__tool_directory__/hyphaeon_bundle.py' --meme-dir staged/meme --epistasis-dir staged/epistasis --dms-dir staged/dms --splits-nwk-dir staged/splits_nwk --splits-csv-dir staged/splits_csv --aln-dir staged/aln --element-identifiers '$element_identifiers' --og-identifiers '$og_identifiers' --ortholog-table '$ortholog_table' --ref-bed12 '$ref_bed12' --sizes '$ref_sizes' --ref-column '$ref_column' --site-p-cutoff $site_p_cutoff --bundle-id '$bundle_id' --bundle-version '$bundle_version' --as-dir autosql --out-dir bundled

param.name: codon_alignments
param.label: Per-orthogroup codon alignments
param.help: The original untrimmed pal2nal alignments (element identifier = orthogroup id); needed for gap-aware alignment-codon to reference-codon mapping.

param.name: element_identifiers
param.label: HyphAeon element identifiers
param.help: collection_element_identifiers output over the HyphAeon output collections (one orthogroup id per line in v0).

param.name: og_identifiers
param.label: Orthogroup element identifiers
param.help: collection_element_identifiers output over the codon_alignments collection.

param.name: ortholog_table
param.label: Ortholog table (TSV)
param.help: WF-E consensus ortholog_table.tsv; needs orthogroup_id, label, n_strains, max_copies, clique, density and one column per strain.

param.name: ref_bed12
param.label: Reference gene BED12
param.help: Reference-strain protein-coding gene models; column 4 = gene ID (isoform suffix stripped).

param.name: ref_sizes
param.label: Reference chrom sizes
param.help: Two-column TSV chrom<TAB>length for the reference assembly.

param.name: ref_column
param.label: Reference strain column
param.help: Ortholog-table column header of the reference strain; also the reference FASTA record name.

validator.message: Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot only

param.name: site_p_cutoff
param.label: Site p-value cutoff
param.help: Codon sites also enter the sites track when p_value <= this cutoff (in addition to all q <= 0.10 sites).

param.name: bundle_id
param.label: Bundle identifier
param.help: Strain-panel identifier written into the TACC manifest (e.g. panel5).

validator.message: Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot only

param.name: bundle_version
param.label: Bundle version
param.help: Version string written into the TACC manifest.

validator.message: Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot only

tool.help:
**HyphAeon bundle** — collects per-orthogroup HyphAeon results and emits the comparative-genomics assets.
In v0 every alignment is analyzed whole and every collection element is keyed by the bare `{og}` identifier. Codon coordinates are projected onto the reference genome through the reference BED12 (CDS exon blocks, strand-aware, gap-aware via the reference row of each untrimmed alignment). v0 reports descriptive statistics only (site-level HyphAeon p/q-values and site-call counts) -- no gene-level omnibus or extreme-value statistic is emitted.
**Outputs:** `selection_sites.bed` (BED9+7, codon resolution), `orthogroup.bed` (BED12, membership colored by ortholog-table `label`), `bigSelectionSites.as` for `bedToBigBed`, the per-OG summary and MultiQC tables, and `tacc_comparative_bundle.tar.gz` (manifest + tables + per-gene JSON payloads for the BRC comparative-genomics UI).
Every BED is guaranteed non-empty — `bedToBigBed` fails on a 0-line file, so a fallback sentinel row is emitted when a track would otherwise be empty.
Recombination handling is out of scope for this v0 wrapper: no recombination inputs are accepted and no tract track is emitted. Recombination-aware partitioning is planned upstream in the HyphAeon monorepo (`rhizaeon partition`, `hyphaeon merge`); its output contract will be wired in a future version once it lands.
